cases.assessment: Joint SQL returns116 titles satisfying both lexical groups before independent caps truncate them. Anti64 Saltburn/Gemstones/WhiteLotus/Favourite provide direct wealth/class plus dark-comedy support among top5, materially stronger than English KillingIt/CrimeSceneCleaner/OnAir. However #3 RaspberryReich is revolutionary-gang satire with a rich hostage, not centrally rich people; this remains a subject-relation weakness, especially against strongest stock English phrase. Raw joint Saltburn/KillingIt/Gemstones also improves conjunction; anti is a tradeoff, not indisputably better at every rank. RRF and lexical75 promote broader satire and do not repair that issue. Tail KingOfComedy/Quills should not be treated as proven wealthy-subject matches merely from lexical eligibility.

cases.assessment: Joint13 pool retains complete getaway/chase conjunction. Anti64 Drive/BabyDriver/Motorway are direct getaway-driver stories; BabyDriver/Motorway explicitly emphasize chases. Drive source emphasizes character-driven bursts of action rather than nonstop chasing, but request prefers getaway over city destruction, so no hard failure. Heaven’sBurning high-stakes chase and ExecutiveTarget coerced getaway also support scope. Raw joint ExecutiveTarget/DriveHard/Motorway is already directly relevant; unfamiliar ExecutiveTarget is not inferior by familiarity. Original corrected and phrase are likewise strong. This is evidence of a cheaper focused route, not an unequivocal quality win over the strongest cheap alternative.
